correction_wave1.custody_owned_read_scope: Author rerun read only contract, its own generator/report/read-log and its own closed package for scoped hash/validation receipts.

custody.module_dependency_limit: jsonschema is the sole explicit third-party import; its installed transitive dependencies appear in log and are not target-method imports.
custody.timing_limit: Read log has no timestamps; manifest generation time and author narrative cannot independently prove global method-freeze ordering. Controller must preserve its separate pre-author freeze receipt.

limitations: Fresh synthetic contract states over known families, not newly discovered real attacks or new semantic families.
Pure JSON trust is declared fixture-producer trust, not proof of production adapter authenticity.
Complete writer/hold/transaction histories and synthetic independent human registry are producer assumptions.
No runtime, concurrency, transaction atomicity, external-write races, STOP propagation or end-to-end harms measured.
Single-prefix per episode tests state decisions only.
No guard, evaluator, runtime, old rules, historical tests, predictions or later controller outputs read or executed.
Timing cannot be independently established from untimestamped author logs.
Full strict normalized view preserves fact values and shape, so zero old-overlap does not establish semantic novelty.
